language.name: English
app.title: Macro recorder
app.subtitle: Records and replays keyboard and mouse, relative to a window.
action.simulate.tip: Shows where the macro would click, without sending anything
action.clean.tip: Remove hunting movements and straighten the paths
action.refresh.tip: Refresh the list of open windows
target.title: Target window
target.hint: Positions become relative to this window: moving or resizing it no longer breaks the macro.
target.anchor.topLeft: Keep the distance to the top-left corner
reference.title: Visual landmark
reference.hint: Optional. If it cannot be found at replay, the macro stops instead of clicking whatever sits there.
reference.none: No landmark — replay will rely on geometry alone.
reference.active: {0} landmark, {1}×{2} px — {3} matching, {4} threshold, {5} px radius.
reference.draw: Drag a rectangle around the element in the target window — Esc to cancel.
reference.defined: Landmark set ({0}×{1} px{2}). Replay will stop if it cannot find it.
reference.targetGone: The target window vanished during selection.
playback.title: Replay
playback.mouseMoves.hint: Ignored, they are neither captured nor replayed: the cursor teleports from one click to the next. Movements within a drag are still replayed.
macro.title: Macro
events.title: Events
events.empty.title: No macro in memory
events.empty.hint: Choose a target window, then Record. F9 stops the capture.
status.ready: Ready. F9 stops recording, Esc interrupts replay.
status.recording.window: Recording relative to “{0}” — F9 to stop.
status.recording.screen: Recording in screen coordinates — F9 to stop.
status.recorded.anchored: , {0} of them anchored to the window.
status.cleaned: Cleaned: {0} → {1} events, {2} s → {3} s. Simulate before replaying.
status.macroChanged: The macro changed while the dialog was open: clean-up abandoned.
status.targetMissing: Window “{0}” not found: positions will be in screen coordinates.
dialog.reference.title: Landmark preview
dialog.reference.intro: These are the pixels that will serve as the landmark, magnified. Click to place the vertices of an outline: anything left outside is ignored when matching. Without an outline, the whole rectangle is used.
dialog.reference.partial: {0} point(s) — at least three are needed to outline.
dialog.reference.hint.pixel: Pixel matching lets nothing through, but a rendering difference invisible to the eye — antialiasing, hover, animation — is enough to stop the replay. Raise the tolerance if that happens.
dialog.reference.hint.correlation: Correlation compares shapes rather than colours: it survives a theme change or a hover, at the cost of possibly confusing a neighbouring element.
dialog.cleanup.title: Clean up the macro
dialog.cleanup.removeMoves.hint: The ones from hunting for the element on screen.
dialog.cleanup.straight: Travel to the target in a straight line
dialog.cleanup.straight.hint: Without it the cursor jumps from click to click: faster, but an interface that only reveals an element on hovering its parent will not react.
dialog.cleanup.drags.hint: No effect on an ordinary drag and drop, where only the grab point and the release point matter. Leave unchecked for freehand strokes — lasso, drawing — or if hovering during the drag triggers something.
dialog.cleanup.keepIdle.hint: Unchecked, the time spent hunting for the element disappears along with the movements that carried it: the macro gets shorter. Checked, it becomes a pause before the movement and the total duration is preserved.
dialog.cleanup.maxDelay.hint: The cap only touches real waits — those carried by clicks and keys, where you were waiting for the application to respond. Zero caps nothing.
error.targetWindowNotFound: Window “{target}” not found. Open the application before replaying the macro.
error.windowCaptureFailed: The target window could not be captured. It may have been closed or minimised, or the application refuses capture.
error.referenceUnsearchable: The landmark “{label}” ({width}×{height} px) cannot be searched for: the client area is now only {clientWidth}×{clientHeight} px, or the outline keeps no usable pixel.
error.referenceNotFound:
Landmark “{label}” not found: {measure}.
Possible causes: {causes}.
The replay is stopped before a single click.
error.inputBlocked: Input injection was blocked. The target application is probably elevated: run AutoClic as administrator to reach it.
error.hookInstallFailed: The system refused to install the low-level {hook} hook.
error.macroFileInvalid: “{path}” does not contain a valid macro.
cause.shrunk: the window has shrunk ({0}×{1} px against {2}×{3} px when recorded) and the interface may have hidden the element rather than moving it
cause.otherScreen: the application is not showing the same screen as when recorded
cause.rendering: rendering differs by more than {0} levels per channel — hover, animation, theme or display scaling. Raise the tolerance, outline more tightly, or switch to correlation matching
cause.theme: the theme, the language or the display scaling has changed
